data.desc: Toppoint Holdings Inc. (NYSE American: TOPP) is a truckload services and solutions provider focused on the recycling export supply chain. The Company transports waste paper, scrap metal and logs to the ports of Newark, NJ and Philadelphia, PA, provides import transportation services at those ports, and serves markets including Tampa, Jacksonville and Miami, FL; Baltimore, MD; and Houston, TX. The Company is incorporated in Delaware and headquartered in North Wales, Pennsylvania.
